title: Michelle Never Misses
style: soft pop ballad, female lead vocal warm and confident, acoustic piano, brushed drums, upright bass, light strings, dreamy proud uplifting, 92 bpm, sunny gentle feel
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle steps up to the line
Quiet and calm, taking her time
Bright yellow ball in her sight
Michelle is gonna get it right

[Verse 2]
Paddle face open, soft little touch
Michelle does not need very much
One sweet swing, one gentle push
The ball lands soft, not in a rush

[Chorus]
Michelle never misses, Michelle finds the line
Michelle on the court doing just fine
Smooth as honey, sweet as a song
Michelle on the court is where she belongs

[Verse 3]
No big shout, no fancy spin
Michelle just plays and lets the ball in
Light little arc, soft little fall
Michelle and her bright yellow ball

[Chorus]
Michelle never misses, Michelle finds the line
Michelle on the court doing just fine
Smooth as honey, sweet as a song
Michelle on the court is where she belongs

[Bridge]
Friends on the side cheering her name
Michelle is winning her gentle game
No loud noise, no big show
Just Michelle and the ball, soft and slow

[Outro]
Michelle never misses…
Michelle finds the line…
Michelle on the court… doing just fine…
